mandatory_checks_failed.defect: Thick white bevel/highlight, glossy translucent pills and raised controls resemble a familiar glossy casual-game skin; not a convincing modernization over the flatter original.
mandatory_checks_failed.repair: Remove in-game HAVENLINE/Camp brand card; use compact avatar/status. Flatten surfaces, use hairline or absent borders and restrained shadows, tighten status organization, and retain one vivid Build accent.

mandatory_checks_failed.defect: Double silver perimeter and framed/gradient gray controls give the otherwise useful dark rail/dock direction a dated chrome-widget appearance.
mandatory_checks_failed.repair: Keep rail-to-bottom-dock adaptation, but remove metallic/raised outlines. Use flat matte charcoal surfaces, quiet dividers/spacing and one warm primary Build accent. Preserve readable map expansion affordance.

alpine_minor_refinement: Optional polish: slightly reduce pill-edge sheen and shadows while preserving warm cream/sage softness and dark-on-gold primary action. No blocking visual defect was found within this concept scope.
verified_visual_observations: All three actual boards show landscape and portrait arrangements.
Minimap labels and outward expansion arrows are visible in both views of all boards.
No visible UI cutoff or collision between controls was found.
Both camp gates/openings and the centered furnace are retained in all views.
Gameplay remains broadly visible and the primary Build action is clear.
All three reduce the original bottom navigation density; Ember changes the navigation structure most.
format_caveat: Landscape concept frames are around 4:3 rather than matching the portrait phone aspect after rotation. This is an acknowledged illustrative-format limit, not device responsiveness proof or a failed concept requirement.
next_action: Repair Aurora and Ember, retain Alpine as the current strongest passing direction, then inspect the actual revised images and compare all three again.
